full_text: May not Last but the Customer Service by Manufacturer is outstanding! sounds great, if only it would last longer than a month or so. This is the second of these that I have purchased and both units died after less than 2 months of use. It still sounds out that the bluetooth connection has been made but no sound is sent to that radio. Probably either the bluetooth or FM broad cast side has died. UPDATE 05-13-2016: The Manufacturer contacted me after this review and sent me 2 new units to replace the ones that died. I don't expect these to last any longer that the first two units but this service response is the best I have experienced hands down. So I will upgrade my review to 4 stars. If these units last more than 3 months, I will upgrade to 5 stars.

Awesome!!!! I thought this was great... until my left bud went out just out of the blue, and I've only had it for about 2 months. It's past my 30 day return period so I'm stuck with a half dead $50+ string. It seems some products will barely last past the return date period, then goes out, forcing you to buy another one. I'm guessing sweat got into it and ruined it.... even though it's suppose to be sweat proof. Won't be buying this brand anymore. -- UPDATED REVIEW-- So after I posted the above review, I was surprised to find that Celecity contacted me and offered to ship me a brand new one free of charge! So I said, ok, I'll try it out for about a month and see how it goes. If I'm happy, I'll update my review. So here it is, it works prefectly well still with no issues! I'm very satisified and even upped my star rating. Now it's worth 5 stars, even more so because of the great customer service and their offer to make things right. That's what customer satisfaction is about! And in terms of the quality of these earbuds, still great! Knowing that they have this level of customer service, I'll be sure to buy from them again. Happy camper now!

WARNING! DO NOT BUY!!!  Dead Hard drive after a few months I waited to make a review most of these reviews below are right after purchase. These drives are faulty. You can hear them click when copying files to them. I used my on occasion only when I had to leave town. After a few months of using my hard drive a couple times a month it died. So then you have to call Seagate to do a return which they then tell you will cost $50. I returned mine and received another one, same issue 5 months later drive will no longer open and I lost all my data again. Do not buy!

Failed at 12 months. ARGHHHH!!!!!! I have used Kingston's for years. This one was slow out of the box. Then exactly one year later it has failed...full of a solid year's worth of work! I have used the previous model (2.0) for years with no problems. I am going back to the old discontinued model while I can still find it. I am getting a write protected error and none of the recovery methods is working.

Good Luck my Tivo is now a Boat Anchor wth no rope attached Bought mine over a year ago and won't work without big $$$$ lifetime plan. You an purchase this Tivo Cheaper than I who purchased the same product over a year ago and paid $150 for a year's basic service can buy a lifetime service plan. I have contacted Tivo multiple times about this and other problems and never received a response. The only time Tivo contacted me was to attempt to renew my $150 a year basic service plan. Good luck if they offer new customer's a better deal because I can't even shame Tivo into giving me a fair deal. Another problem I had was that their "suggested" programs kept suggesting Spanish language programs when I never watched anything other than English programming. Tech support is non existent. I have a couple hundred dollar boat anchor with Tivo on the front ( if your smart you won't tie a rope to this anchor. Save your money and buy a Channel Master DVR+. The tv guide is free and streaming stations are available through the guide at their regular prices ( some are free). The name Tivo used to mean something, now it means open your wallet and don't expect loyalty upgrades or tech support. Good Luck!!!!!!

This company has the WORST customer service I have ever encountered BUYER BEWARE! I have had these cards for less than 4 months and twice now BOTH cards that came with this kit have stopped working. Neither my desktop nor my laptop recognized the device when I plugged it into the card reader or without the card reader into the laptop. I have now lost 600+ photos plus the hours that I spent taking the photos. My husband also tried to download or recover the data and was unable to. The camera advised us to "wipe" the memory card the first time this happened and since I had only taken about 20 photos at the time I told him that was fine. He wiped the card, I lost those photos, and the card started working again. I assumed it was just a fluke and not a faulty card until it happened again today. I just got off the phone with SanDisk and they basically told me to go to hell. They gave me three options: 1. Contact 1 or 2 companies to pay out of my pocket to (possibly) recover the data on the cards. 2. Forget recovering the data and just return the faulty cards back to them. I would then have to wait an ADDITIONAL 7-10 business days to get the new cards. 3. Pay $15 out of my own pocket to get 2 cards "expedited" to me to use in the meantime, which would still take 3-4 business days to get here. When I finally spoke to the managers manager he said that he could waive the $15 shipping fee for now, but that if I didn't then return the faulty cards in a timely manner that I would penalized $12 and $20 for both cards. Seriously, probably the worst customer service I've ever encountered. They acted like it was MY fault (the paying customer) that their product was faulty and that I should be punished by either losing my photos or paying fees, not to mention the additional time that it would take to take care of all of this. In the meantime and since I have to re-take all of my photos I will be going out to purchase an SD card from any other company that makes them because I will no longer give SanDisk my business and I will also be filing a report with the BBB against SanDisk. Hopefully Amazon takes stock of issues like these with the companies that are permitted to sell on their site and takes appropriate action against these companies, as well as assisting their future customers who may be unaware of the issues and problems that SanDisk causes for Amazon's customers.

Terrible qualuty, terrible customer service. Bad quality. Stopped working in less than a year. Called Samsyn custoner servuce and they promised to send a new one. They did NOTHING! Never buying a Samsund brand again. Too bad my cellphone is Samsung.

Great customer service. After 1 year of owning started to cause whatever was connected to it to flash blue every few seconds, contacted UPTab with my amazon order number and getting a replacement shipped out no hassle. Would recommend.

disapointed!! Update, I purchased my unit on 12/3/16. It is now 2/13/17 and I performed a map update and now a number of the features such as voice command no longer work. I talked with customer service and found out that because there is not enough memory in the Garmin unit that I will have to purchase an SD card to get more memory. When I asked why I was told that the Garmin 2689 was not made with sufficient memory to hold all of the USA maps because it is a 2014 year model, I thought I was purchasing a new 2016 year model. I will purchase the SD card and hopefully this will correct the problem. I am very disappointed that Garmin would sell something that can not hold the maps that it is advertised for.

Won't last a year Great while it worked, but within 6 months one side of the headphones no longer work. The headphone jack looks like it has corroded a bit. Update - Just about a year in and the player has completely stopped working. Cannot charge. Cannot play. Buy a different brand. One that can last at LEAST a year before breaking.

Garbage... Fails to do its job...Dead & can't be revived.... Garbage..... that was made in China, so no surprise. Finally plugged in the strip. After a couple of days, I came home to find it did not turn on when I went to turn on the strip. The reset button failed to do anything. In fact, the reset button was just sort of halfway in the hole and halfway inside the strip. $36 flat stolen out of my wallet on this thing. Nice looking concept, but Epic Failure in terms of quality. UPDATE: 04AUG2016 - I discovered messages from sellers and manufacturers in my account. Hey Amazon, why do the Sent & Received message boxes for those pretty important folks not show new messages like the Amazon mailboxes? If you read this Krystal, I'd love to take you up on the offer of a replacement, NOT the refund, and give this another try BECAUSE I love the design and potential of the product. At that point, I'll gladly reassess the device and rating. Treat gently - otherwise a nice tablet for the money I bought two of these at the same time to replace nicer Lenovo tablets that my kids broke. These work very well and I have no complaints about the operation. One of the two tablets lasted less than a month. A small drop (while protected in a case) broke the digitizer. There were no visible cracks, but it quit responding to all touches. That took off one star. The other star comes off for the absolute non-existence of customer support. I could replace the digitizer myself if the manufacturer would help me with the specifics of the replacement part. But I have sent 5 or 6 emails to different addresses and I have never gotten a response from them. I would recommend this product if you baby it, but for kids who might drop it I would look elsewhere. If you break it or have a problem forget getting any tech support out of the manufacturer. EDIT - I got a hold of the manufacturer by replying to their email they sent me where they requested a review after the sale. Originally I was trying their website. Anyway, now that I have gotten a hold of them they are giving me GREAT customer service. Review upgraded.

Lilgadgets ear buds Update: 12-1-17 I am updating my review of this product based on the excellent customer service I have received. Not only did they reach out to me to replace the original pair of earbuds but they refunded my purchase price for the pair I bought a couple of months ago. They have been nothing but helpful and prompt. This is the second pair (and last) of these I have purchased for my son. I like the fact that they limit the volume. I don't like that they don't last. I purchased the first pair a little over a year ago and they went out after about 10 months. I have a 12 year olds boy so I figured he was just hard on them. The second pair went out yesterday on a long car ride from Florida to Tennessee. They were only 2 months old. He kept them in the case when not in use. Did not help. They were just outside the return window to Amazon. I will reach out to the manufacture to see if I can get a replacement.

Awesome buy Bought these back in September and use them 5-7 days a week for the gym. Never had a problem, they do not bother my ear at all, sound quality is great. Very happy with these!! Update: 3/28/16 sadly they had stopped working on me and I immediately purchased another pair. I thought I'd email the company and I'm glad I did! Excellent customer service! Sent me a shipping label to return the defective pair and since I had already purchased a new pair they refunded me the purchase price. They had offered to send me out a new pair. Outstanding service great headphones!!

Service did get back to me Update 7/21/2016 A Customer Service rep did get back to me. He seemed quite familiar with this problem. The camera was not unpairing from the monitor it was just losing power repeatedly. He asked whether I had used the provided red clips to connect the camera to my backup light wires or soldered them. I used the red clips that came with the camera and used a pair of pliers to crimp them on as described in the directions. He said that the red clips had probably come loose and I might need to redo the connection and solder them in place. I took the liner out of my trunk and re-crimped the red clips with a pair of pliers. Then I took some electrical tape and wound it around the red clips very tightly, stretching it as I wound. I am hoping this holds the connection tight. It did fix my problem for the time being. If the fix doesn't hold I will have to find a different more reliable connector to use. I don't relish the idea of soldering after market anything into my electrical system. These clips failed after about 4,000 miles of driving. I don't drive much. I bought this backup camera in December of 2014 at Costco. I loved it for about a year, now I hate it. It keeps unpairing the monitor from the camera and I have to try, repeatedly, to pair it and I usually get a "pair failed" message. So I read the manual and it says to call customer service when this happens. Ya, right. The first call they told me they couldn't hear anyone on the line and hung up. I heard them just fine. So I called again. Then I got the "overflow department". They said someone would call me right back. Ya, right. That was 2 1/2 hours ago so I called them back. Got hung up on again when I told her not to lie to me about calling "right back". So I called again. This time I asked for a supervisor. She said that the overflow department can't contact a supervisor and that they can't directly contact the service department. Ya, right. So I told her I was going to write a scathing review on Amazon and Costco.com and asked her to be sure and take down my name because it would be on the review. Stay clear of this piece of junk. Automotive equipment should last a lot longer than this and if the manual is going to tell you to call the service department for help there should actually be a service department.

Faulty GPU, buyer beware The MacBook is a great product. However, I guess I should have done more research. I got a great package- i7, Solid State hard drive, the works. However, not long after the 30 day "return period" it has become completely unusable. I found out after a trip to the Apple Store that the GPU has failed. Apparently this is common for this particular model, but Apple is no longer replacing them for free. Apple's solution is a new logic card since it is attached to it. The seller Laptop Jacks has only offered for me to purchase the very expensive part and then ship it back to them to install. While I can't prove it, I know there is a process called re-flowing which will get the GPU to work again, but it is generally a pretty temporary fix. I believe that might have been done to sell this computer. It also came with an unusable charger that was held together with electric tape. So, I've basically lost my money unless Amazon can do something about it. Buyer beware. * UPDATE 1/24/18 I had a professional repair person fix the GPU and I am expecting this laptop to be back to working order once I get the logic board back. They said that the GPU was burnt and there were unprofessional attempts at repair and reflow on the GPU. So basically they did a hack job repair that worked for just long enough for the Amazon return period to pass. DO NOT BUY FROM LAPTOP JACKS INC.

UPDATE: simply amazing customer service These headphones are not for people who sweat alot during their workouts. Dont get me wrong, the sound quality is the best Ive ever heard out of any in ear headphones, but after a couple months of heavy cardio, boxing, the right earbud crapped out and no sound comes out of it anymore....I assume from repeated sweat damage, as I took very good care of them. UPDATE: Jaybirds contacted me directly and first walked me through resetting the headphones to factory settings and when that didn't work, they simply had me send them a picture of me faulty earbuds cut with scissors and I had a brand new pair of jaybirds in my ears within 2 weeks. Like I said in the initial review, the sound quality is unparalleled for its price and I daresay it outperforms products twice the cost *cough*powerbeats*,,,, I must have gotten a faulty pair...but its not for the great sound quality that i bump my review to 5 stars, but for simply amazing customer service...I have not experienced such quick customer service like that...like....ever. When I say 2 weeks, it way more like a week and a half....they expedited the package! If I can consistently expect this kind of customer service, then logitech just made me a product loyalist!

I am on my THIRD LG 31MU97-B. The first ... I am on my THIRD LG 31MU97-B. The first one died after a year. Would not turn back on. The second had the Display Port fail (only the left half of the screen works). I'm now using a replacement unit, making this the third one. The low price is not so low when you consider that you'll be replacing it about once a year on average. I should have bought the Eizo ColorEdge, at five times the price. Chances are I've lost that much in productive billable hours just dealing with the idiots at LG who don't know how to send the right replacement monitor. It took three months to get the first unit replaced. They kept sending me VGA monitors and then finally a 4K monitor with a huge clump of black pixels in the center of the screen. That one lasted from October to May. Now I need to get it replaced. Again. Next time, I'm taking out a loan and buying a QUALITY monitor, instead of buying these cheap junkers for cash.

Total mixed bag. Awesome drive, then dead drive, no customer service, then great customer service, new replacement  *updated* Since Amazon likes to mix reviews together sometimes, I'll mention up front that this is for the Adata su800 256gb SSD. This worked great for just at 6 months, then it went from blazing fast SSD to something rivaling 5 1/4" floppy disk transfer speeds, then dead. Adata was initially no help but when I finally was able to get a reply, they actually replaced the dead drive with a brand new retail packaged drive with no hassle at all. Turnaround time was around a week and a half. I did have to pay return shipping, but that's pretty much standard everywhere. (I think the no-reply problem I had the first several attempts at contacting them, may have been some sort of issue between the tablet browser I was initially using and their web forms. After a friend suggested it as a possible issue, tried contacting them again using chrome on a desktop, and received a reply quickly) Still haven't decided if I will use the replacement or go with something else.

Lasted Three Months before it Failed Initially happy with laptop but after several months of occasional and gentle use, the screen started to flicker on and off when rotating screen or while sitting on the desk. Had to send laptop in for repairs. Still waiting for it to be returned. Online status indicates parts had to be ordered. No information given as to what, whether they are or are not in stock, no idea of how long it might be before parts arrive. Contacting customer support by phone resulted on not information beyond a screen being ordered. Support couldn't give me any idea if part was in stock or not nor any idea of how long the laptop would be in service. This was my first Lenovo laptop of many that I have owned. All have lasted beyond three years. This one lasted 3 months. I am disappointed that it failed but even more disappointed in the poor process and communication by Lenovo.

Great Product I purchased this product from Amazon. My purchase included a lifetime subscription, which made all the difference in my choice. TIVO has the best software for a Digital Video Recorder. Since I am a "snowbird" and only spend 6 months at my TIVO location, I could not justify the $15/mo subscription on a year round basis, but the lifetime subscription solved that problem for me.

Amazing customer service I wrote a review on this about a month ago, and it seems to have disappeared. . . I originally gave it 2 stars, as it stopped working after the first use, but the time that it worked, sounded great. I am new at returning things, so I didn't try to contact the company since by the time I realized the problem, it was past the return date. I took that responsibility on myself. Within a week, I had an email from the company apologizing for the inconvenience, and explaining that there had been similar problems with the batch that ours came in. They offered to refund every penny we'd spent, and did not ask us to return it. All they asked of me was the serial number found on the bottom of the device. To me, this is outstanding customer service! I was just going to let it go, but they took it on themselves to contact me and refund the money. They have won my respect and my business. I would give the customer service 5 stars! I am giving the product 4 stars as the quality of the device and the sound was very good when it worked, and if it weren't for the defect, it would have been a great stereo. I'm convinced that the ones not in the batch that we got ours out of would be fantastic.

Not Reliable I purchased a total of 6 eeros -- 4 for one residence and 2 for another. They worked OK for about 1 year. The devices then started not allowing some of the computers and other devices within the household connect. It would only allow one laptop and the FireStick to connect. I contacted service twice. I was told that they knew of the problem, but it might take months to resolve. Although the service technicians were very enthusiastic to help, they could not solve the problem. I was told that I need to wait for the fix. I have about $800 invested in these products with the expectation of eero being an exceptional product. I cannot continue with lack of connection for months. I now have to purchase Google WiFi to replace my expensive, but useless, eero devices. I am very disappointed by this outcome.

Potential device, perhaps buggy firmware - good customer service! I am not sure if I just had a bad unit or not. This router will lock me up in every 48-72 hours of time. Once locked up you cannot do anything other than rebooting or resetting to factory defaults. I have tried all possible available latest firmwares for UTT AC750GW including the social version they have made available for amazon customers via specified link provided in on of the review comments by UTT. UTT's Chicago, IL based channel partners are much helpful providing tech support. However, there is no dedicated customer service. Support available from M-F during normal business hours. Turn around time is like 1-2 response per day. When the unit fails completely, this kind of support is not enough to get it right. With my personal experience with the device, I would give it a star, but I have added two more stars, just because they tried their best to help me to fix the situation. I had to replace my router with  Ubiquiti Networks Edgerouter Lite 3Port Router (ERLITE-3)  - which is working perfectly fine for almost a week now.

Great purchase So I know I had recommended this but now I am not so sure. I had expected it to last for more than a year; however right on the brink of 12 months it just stopped charging my laptop. So I either have to take my chances and buy another one from Amazon or get one directly from Dell.. very disappointed.

Great customer service Bought 2. One has work as expected for a long time, up to 4-5 hours of normal laptop use, the other one drained completely after some months. EDIT: After my first review, I was contacted by customer service (totally unexpected for me) and they quickly proposed a solution, which took place in only 2 days. Amazing, even after a year. Best customer service ever. The working battery have has a very intense use since almost 2 years and it still has 4 hs life (the expected battery life for my pc). Totally recommended.

Horrible unit, problems since the day I pluged it in. Mine is several years old, but my replacement won't be a Sony I have one of these, almost every time I go to turn it on, I have to unplug and plug it in again, before it will power up. Well after doing that for several years, now it doesn't power up at all. If you look on the internet, there are many, many owners with the same problem. To correct it all you have to do is send the unit in for repair (at your expense), pay for the repair, wait 2-3 weeks and you'll get it back. This is a "known defect" in early models. It is cheaper to just buy something else, and dump the unit!

Defective. Update I have since changed this to 3 stars (from 1) for the customer service. While at first it was formulaic and scripted, they did right by me (the customer) in the end. I appreciate that. ********************* (I think the products worth it, but I still feel as if I might have been unlucky and gotten a bad one some how. I say that based on experience) Ordered January 2017 Installed on brand new Tablet (literally right out of the box) Used head lamp, gloves, tools provided, and my own tools to make a Ultra clean and dust free surface. Perfect install - NO bubbles, dust, particulate present. What's the problem? As seen in the pictures, I'm having an issue with JUST the edges of this screen protector. My quick and only assumption is that it's a defect from the manufacturing process. Pushing down doesn't remove the line (like it might with a bubble) and I don't want to pull on it because that's only going to shorting the lifespan that it currently has. But my assumption is that it's going to be a weak point where dust, dirt, and air get into, and cause a failure of the screen protector. My bigger problem? Is that when I was sent an email follow up about how I liked the product, I responded with the truth. I wrote a simple, but detailed email back explaining my concerns, along with pictures of the issue. But I got back a very scripted and cookie cutter response about how dust will do that, sorry you suck (I'm paraphrasing of course). That's my only reason for even writing this - The product seems okay. I probably got unlucky for some reason (though admittedly I've NEVER seen a screen protect behave like that) And it was nice to get a follow up unprompted email. BUT THEN? You ignore what I have to say and copy paste a response? That doesn't sit well with me. Keep your $3 dollar refund. I'll survive the harsh winter without it. ------------------------------------------------------------------- "Hello Mario, Thank you for your recent purchase from our SPARIN line of products. Your order was shipped at 2017-01-12, it should have been delivered or will be there shortly. Here's the order information: View Order Your satisfaction is extremely important to the team here at SPARIN, if you have any questions or concerns please just reply this email, we will be here to make everything goes right for you. I am sure you know that product reviews and seller feedback are critically important on Amazon to both the buyers and the sellers. If you are satisfied with the product, please take a moment to submit a product review here: Thank you so much and have a good day. Best Regards, SPARIN Customer Support Team" --------------------------------------------- "I'm actually having problems/concerns. I had a perfect application of my product (15th + time I've put on a screen protector on a device). A day after I had a perfect application, I noticed the edges on the top and bottom appeared to be lifting up every so slightly. 80% on the top, 5% on the bottom, and it's not all in one area. It's thin - about 1 mm, and perfectly parallel with the top/bottom. It has me very concerned that this is the beginning of the screen protector coming loose. Not sure why or how this would be happening. But with my experience, once an edge starts lifting, the rest is surely to follow. In addition, this screen was placed on a brand new Tablet - literally removed from the box 5 seconds before I applied the screen protector. I've attached pictures. Thank you for your time." ------------------------------------------------- "Hello Mario, Thank you very much for contacting us, this is Vanessa, please don't worry, I will assist you with the issue. Generally speaking, this tempered glass screen protector should adhere to the device by itself and leaves no bubble, but when dust particles appears during installation, bubbles or edge not adhere may happen, we really hope you could understand it. For better to solve this issue, we would like to partial refund ($3) you, is this solution OK with you? If any suggestion or opinion, please feel free to let me know, I will be here for help! Sincerely Vanessa" ----------------------------------------------- "That was quite a scripted reply and I don't appreciate that. If you looked at the pictures (or read my last email), you would see it isn't dust. It's a line right at the edge of the top that goes about 80% of the way across. Dust doesn't do that. I don't know what does, but dust makes bubbles. (additional problems at the very bottom, as shown in the pictures) This went onto a new tablet that was right out of the packaging. Even still, I cleaned the screen, and used your tools (and my own) to eliminate any particulate that was present. There are no bubbles. It was a perfect install. Perfectly aligned. So I get the scripted response because I'm sure plenty of people to get bubbles because of lack of experience, but if you had bothered to look at the provided pictures, you would see that this is something else."

Waste of money for me. Update: I am giving 5 stars as the service is amazing. Thanks to the seller, I got new piece within a week after the my first review even though I ignored to claim the return as 30 days crossed before I can return after first piece died. The new one has quality of sound, great battery life and consistent. I am happy with it. Only good thing is, it sits in the ear perfect. It picks noise to other side of call. It is bulky protruding outside the ear, that is ugly. I tried to compromise and it just died a day before 30 day return period. This is the first time I had such a bad experience in the last 20 years, I do not recommand these. Item is well packed and delivered fast.

WD Caviar Blue, 320 Gb HD lasts and performs consistently well for a LOOOONNNNNGGGGG time! I bought the  Western Digital Caviar Blue WD3200AAJS 320GB 8MB Cache 7200RPM SATA 3.0Gb/s 3.5" Desktop Hard Drive  recently from MD TECH. I bought 3 other WD drives from one other vendor who ran out of this drive recently and I had to switch to MD Tech. The other vendor was superb and I expect the same business from MD Tech. I love these drives. I bought 2 Caviar Blue 320 Gb drives (SATA) and one 160 Gb (IDE), all WD's in the past and none have shown a glitch, and that after a very traumatic move to a new apartment having to hire some real jerks to move my stuff. All but this one easily survived the move. This one was just bought, so, no serious physical movement to the drive other than what goes on in shipping. It is way too soon to evaluate anything you buy from Amazon, but it is more likely you would give a good review and one soon enough affect new buyers, and that you would remember to review it if done very fast. Best customer service! Update: changed review to 5-stars for Anket's customer service. I didn't contact them. But they read my review below and contacted me with an offer to send a different model or provide a refund. I chose the different model which was shipped to me promptly. The new model is much better and their customer service was a pleasure to work with. Thank you! Original review: First, let me say that I really like Anker products. I have a lot of their batteries and cables and they are my usual go-to company for stuff like that. I decided to purchase these to use as worry-free knock-around BT headphones. I'm not really excited about them for the following reasons: 1. Sound quality - I wasn't expecting great sound quality or even good sound quality, but the sound quality on these is average to poor. There is too much treble so music sounds very bright (and not in a good way). 2. Ear tips - everyone's ears are different, but the right ear just won't stay in place. It falls out all the time. I ended up buying a set of Comply foam tips for these with the hope that they would help it stay in my ear. The Comply tips mostly do work in this regard, but it is another $15 added to the cost. Also, the Comply tips didn't go on easily and wear out after a couple months so the cost will go up. I've never had to purchase replacement ear tips for headsets I've bought before. Actually, out of dozens of BT headsets, I've only had one other one that wouldn't stay in my ears... the original Jaybird Bluebirds X. These Ankers have the same problem. 3. The magnetic function - these have a magnet in them which is supposed to hold the 2 ear pieces together. For example, you could wear them around your neck and magnetically attach them at the front when you aren't wearing them. In practice, the magnet is so weak that it barely works. The magnet needs to be made stronger or should be removed. On the positive side: 1. Battery life is good for earbuds of this size. 8 hours is on the high side for this type of device. 2. The cord is just about the perfect length... not too long and not too short. In all fairness, I did not contact Anker prior to posting this review, because the device isn't broken and my return window with Amazon passed before I really got a chance to try these out (which is my fault). At the end of the day, when adding in the cost of the Comply tips I'm pretty sure I could have gotten a much better set of earbuds for the same price that would have fit better. I'll continue to buy Anker products, but will probably stay away from their headsets.

Original Unit had Slot 3 Fail, but Amazon Replacement was Quick I purchased the DS416play after having a lot of experience with Buffalo NAS drives. I had a Buffalo Cloudstor, but the Pogoplug service appeared to be circling the drain, so I decided to go a different route. Received the DS416play and followed the directions to set it up. Set up with four 2 TB drives and the recommended SHR format. Everything went well and the NAS seemed to run fine - for a while. I always to try run in parallel for some time to make sure there are no issues before relying on a new device, which was fortunate. After a few days the device indicated the disk in Slot 3 had crashed. Since the disk has previously been used, I thought it was possible that it could actually have failed. I was able to use the NAS software to repair the drive and it seemed to go back to normal. At this point I had less than 500 GB on the NAS and did not lose any data to the slot 3 issue. However, the drive again failed so I decided to replace it and ordered an new drive from Amazon to install. I was able to install the new drive and set it up (it did take a long time for the parity checks and data transfer), but it seemed to be doing the job. Again, the disk failed, so I though okay maybe I have a new disk that was bad and ordered a replacement drive. By the time I got the new drive, slot 3 could not even see that there was a disk present. Now having purchased two new disks that did not work in Slot 3, I decided to dig deeper and found that the log for slot 3 indicated that the drive had been inserted and removed about every second for several seconds, which pointed to the fact the NAS had a defect in slot 3. I did some research and found at least one other instance of a slot 3 failure in a manner almost identical to the one I found. By this time I had had the NAS for almost a month. I returned the NAS for replacement and got the replacement on free one day shipping (great) from Amazon. I found directions on the Synology website on how to move drives from identical NAS systems and was able to pretty quickly get the new NAS up and running. I was then able to get the disk in slot 3 added to the array (again all the parity checking, etc.) It has been about 10 days now and it seems to be running fine. I like the Synology web interface and the features of the NAS, but would have preferred not to have to do so much troubleshooting which also cost me about $200 for the drives I really did not need. I was able to set up remote access through Synology and with my DNS service. The Android Synology DS apps see okay. The best part of the story is that even if I had not been running in parallel, I would still not have lost any data, which is the purpose of a RAID NAS anyway. Time will tell if the replacement unit has issues, but so far so good. I do think Synology needs to improve their quality, but the features are pretty much as expected.

First, after testing them and writing the review I put them away until it was time to cut the grass. When I tries to use them they would not turn on, but when charged showed full. I used them wired that time and planned to send them back. Before boxing them up I tried repeatedly clicking the power button in case there was some corrosion, and they came to life. (Remember, this problem occurred *before* I first exposed them to sweat.) I have now used them at least 8 times, and they will never turn on until I click the button 10-20 times. Second, even with my iPhone 6 in my front pocket or in a case on my arm there are rather frequent dropouts. Not constant, but enough to be annoying and I have tried the phone on both sides of my body. Long story short, these are barely adequate for my purposes in that the ear cups are holding up, but the power switch is poorly made and may not last. ---------------------- I have only had these for a day and will update if things change. Right up front I want to be very clear that I am subtracting two stars immediately for deceptive advertising. In bold letters on the listing title it says these are noise cancelling headphones, but they most certainly are not. Others have said so in many reviews over a long period of time, so I expected that going in, but it bothers me that the sellers haven't corrected the listing. Second, the listing says right at the top that they are "sweatproof", but there is nothing in the manual or on the box to back that up. Finally, below the title in the description it says that in includes a "deluxe carry hard case", but it does not. You get the cheap cloth bag that many have shown in their pictures. So the Amazon listing says two things that are completely untrue (noise cancelling and included hard case) and one that is untrue or at least unsupported by documentation (sweatproof). (Four really, because it calls them "over the ear" when they are really "on the ear", but many people don't understand the difference so I'll give them that one.) To be clear, having read the reviews I understood all of that and ordered them anyway. I need something to wear while cutting the grass, and the ear pieces on my Bose over-the-ear headphones recently self-destructed from the sweat. Replacement pads are on the way, but I wanted something that could survive. Many said they use these for exactly my use-case and they both survived the sweat and blocked sound well, so I'm giving them a shot even if the listing is misleading in many ways. So far so good is all I can say. They paired with my iPhone 6 easily, and sound good enough to this non-audiophile. Some have had problems with the left side not working correctly, but mine are fine so far. Though they are not noise-cancelling they do fit tightly against the ear and do a good job of blocking out outside sounds (making them "noise isolating" rather than "noise cancelling"). Once I have used them for the rest of the season I plan to update this review to say how they deal with sweat. So far I'll say that if not for the very misleading listing I would likely have given them 4 or 5 stars for use while working outdoors.

Beginning Gaming Platform First things first, I was an avid PC enthusiast during the early pentium 2 days, when nvidia first became a thing. Since then though I have been a dedicated console gamer. I had been thinking about building a rig for awhile, but was intimidated by how much the industry has changed since the days of 150kbps d/l speeds. I decided to buy a prebuilt machine for the sake of configuration. I went to BB and bought a Lenovo Smartcenter 700 for $550, and was not impressed when I got home. I bought it knowing I would eventually upgrade the graphics card to a 900 series sooner or later. Well after a bit of research into upgrading the system, I found that the motherboards chosen in that machine had an odd pin set to the PS, in turn rendering a GPU upgrade impossible. I looked around for awhile on a few other pc sites, and decided to look on amazon. I found this machine that seemed to have the things I was looking for in the price range I was in. After reading the reviews of this machine on here and a few other sites, I decided to go with it. Nearly every review mentions loose cables upon arrival, ranging from HDD to GPU to PSU, so as soon as it arrived I opened the case to have a look at some of the wiring and see if the water cooling system was intact. Not only was the WCS intact, the wire management in this case is unbelievable. There were a few cables with loose ends I noticed. So, immediately I rang support. A few of the reviews said they waited hours on hold to get a rep, but were greeted with great service. Well maybe I got a good day, because the music didn't even play, and I was greeted by a friendly voice willing to help with my questions. A few pictures of the loose ends emailed over to the support while I was on the phone with her. She assured me those were extra cables for fans and/or drives. 5/5 for CS. Also the listing had this machine with a 450w PSU, it cam loaded with a 500w PSU. Awesome stealth upgrade. Zotac GTX 960 AMP! GPU. I had it up and running a few minutes after hanging up with her, and started updating drivers and such. This is by far the quietest machine I have (n)ever heard. Now I don't know the difference in kernels or x32 vs x64 or any of that stuff, so I can say after a few years Windows 10 has already grown on me. I like the customization of where you can put things in your start menu, keeping inline with the XBOX overlay that i'm so used to. I haven't been able to install and play any games yet, so I'll update after I get through a week of testing! Edit 1: Finally got to a game two days after getting the machine. Booted up rust on ultra and played like a dream, ultra smooth 75fps, for about 2 minutes. Then the computer rebooted. I restarted rust, and same thing happened. Next time I tried BioShock, 2007, ran wonderfully in ultra 4k settings. For 5 minutes. I couldn't even get into the bathosphere. I ran cpu-z and MSI afterburner to check my temps during these tests, and the GPU never rose about 70 and the CPU, thanks to the WCS, never got above 55. I called CS and they had me receipt each drive, no problem. Still the same issues. Tried a new RAM stick, same issues. They had me send it in, which is fine, except it happened to be a Friday. So I'm still waiting to get it back. One nice thing that did come from it, is I was able to choose a new color for the case, which ranged from their entire line of colors, not just Amazon's selection. Still docking 2 stars until I get the new one back. Do not recommend...Not fully refurbished/recertified.  Tested/ Benchmarked by tech w/20+ years exp. Sketchy, Slow, read further to know why. On first boot, noticed it was slow, but.. knowing that typically the first boot has many processes going on in the background, after a Sysprep image is launching. First realization there was an issue, could not connect to wifi, on any band, and with multiple access points/ routers. Troubleshooting: connected to LAN fine, tried statically assigning IP/ DNS for WLAN, helped to connect but disconnected quickly. Then proceeded to www.support.dell.com where I learned that Dell doesn't support windows 10 for this model of laptop. i.e. if you have any hardware related issues, and need to download drivers / firmware, you are SOL. See screenshot from Dell's support site, where it shows Windows 7,8,XP, etc, but not Windows 10. 2nd Issue, windows wouldn't auto activate. License key on bottom worked, but that is not something that a "re-certified" pc would have happen. To be classified as re-certified, the pc needs to act just as it would shipped straight from the manufacturer. This is most likely an issue with the SYSPREP process, the seller uses. 3rd Issue, SLOOOOOOOOOWWWWWWW. Ok, here is the tough part for the seller. The laptop works, and looks decent, but most reviews note how slow the laptop is. Here is why. The hard drive passes basic testing (SMART testing/ Western Digital quick tests), but fails extensive tests, and it is obviously a drive that has bad clusters and or read write head mechanical issues. These laptops ship with a platter based / "spinning" hard drive. Laptops are notorious for hard drive issues, as they are moved around with much more frequency than a desktop. Spinning platters spin between 4.2k and 7.2k rpm's, so anytime you move your laptop while it is reading/writing data, or even when its not powered on, you risk damaging the read/write head or in this case, significantly slowing down the capability of the hard drive. Spinning / platter based hard drives usually average between 80 and 120 Mbps read/write speeds (Think Miles per hour, 80 Miles per hour, etc), with an average of 80+ (when new). Over time, with the issues related to the drive being installed in a laptop as noted above, those speeds gradually drop. First test w/out a load (nothing running, just chrome open), this hard drive tested w/ an average of 20 Mbps (again, compare to Miles per hour, driving hoping to get 80MPH, and with the pedal to the floor, only getting 20MPH). As a tech, I recommend replacing hard drives that test w/ an average lower than 40 Mbps. 2nd Test, ran under a load/ with basic operations running. Office, quickbooks, chrome, etc. Yeah.. this got a whopping 2.3 Mbps average read/write speed. So, we have a laptop with a failing hard drive, not supported by Manufacturer w/ the version of windows installed, oh, and with a non manufacturer/ non oem power supply (Explains why another customer noted that their charger stopped working after a few weeks). In summary, This computer fails to meet the most basic Re-certified / refurbished standards. I have had luck with dell refurbished laptops before, I usually just purchase straight from dell, but was on a time crunch w/ this one. Positive note, the seller shipped it via prime, and it did arrive fast. However, with all the issues, simply not worth the hassle. slapping a SSD in this one, and using the devid of the wireless card, found factory firmware updates and drivers for windows 10, which fixed the network connectivity issue.
